g.text: FIGURE 4 · WHY THE QUAD ORDER CANCELS A STEADY DRIFT · SCHEMATIC
true difference 10.0 J · quad estimate 10.0 J
cancels exactly: both sides gain 1.5 J on average
true difference 10.0 J · quad estimate 8.0 J
does not cancel: off by 2 J, carried by the drift allowance
